items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Landkreis Beispielheide eingelegt werden.
items.computation: The scanned Zustellungsurkunde on page 2 shows formal service ('förmliche Zustellung', § 182 ZPO) with the postal carrier noting 'zugestellt am 17.10.2025' — a documented actual delivery date, so the statutory deemed-delivery fiction for ordinary post does not apply; the period runs from this stated delivery day. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (Fri 17 Oct 2025) is not counted, so counting starts Sat 18 Oct 2025. Two weeks (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) from Fri 17 Oct 2025 ends Fri 31 Oct 2025, which is Reformationstag, a public holiday in Niedersachsen (and nationwide since 2018). Under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG the deadline moves to the next working day, Mon 3 Nov 2025.

items.title: Pay the total fine, fee and expenses (Gesamtbetrag)
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, fällig; geben Sie bei der Überweisung bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
items.computation: Payment falls due two weeks after the Bescheid becomes 'rechtskräftig' (final), which happens if no Einspruch is filed within the objection period computed above (ending Mon 3 Nov 2025); the decision then becomes final on Tue 4 Nov 2025. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB that day is not counted, so counting starts Wed 5 Nov 2025; two weeks (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) from Tue 4 Nov 2025 ends Tue 18 Nov 2025, a normal working day in Niedersachsen, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. This date is contingent on no Einspruch being lodged; filing an Einspruch would suspend this payment obligation until the case is otherwise concluded.

warnings: The payment due date (2025-11-18) assumes no Einspruch is filed by the 2025-11-03 deadline; if an Einspruch is lodged, the Bescheid does not become final and this payment date does not apply.

Page 2 is a scan of the delivery envelope (Postzustellungsurkunde) showing 'zugestellt am 17.10.2025' in handwriting; this is the actual, documented delivery date used to start the objection period, not the printed letter date of 13.10.2025.
